market_summary: Across all five tracked symbols, the broader market remains in a strong session downtrend beneath descending VWAP and EMA50 baselines and below session Value Area Lows. However, late New York session participation has slowed significantly, with RVOL across all assets between 0.55 and 0.85 and no yellow volume breakout spikes present. XAUUSD is caught in positive gamma dampening chop around its Gamma Flip, EURUSD and GBPUSD are testing session lows without breakdown volume, XAGUSD is in a tight consolidation range, and BTCUSD is undergoing an unconfirmed mid-channel pullback toward EMA20. All setups currently lack edge, resulting in a defensive HOLD across the entire portfolio.

Price is holding above Session Low (3852.35). Setup lacks edge, recommending HOLD.
